confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on a few 2026 guide and crowd-sourced figures, not an official price survey; cocktail and wine are less certain. Cocktail is set from a beer-based relationship and the wine glass from local pintxo and txakoli price points. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not inspected listings. The FX observation (2026-11-18) was taken from search results that quoted the RBA page, not from a direct read of the RBA table, so verify it against the official RBA daily table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Spain's Basque Country and northern Spanish coastal tourism cities of similar size and July demand, with restaurant prices adjusted using 2026 local guide and price-list data.
